scope: Windows destructive batch admission and shared callback path parsing
status: implementation checkpoint; Windows runtime acceptance outstanding
changes: Validate DOS/UNC case and ordinary/verbatim aliases after stable exact-string deduplication and before admitting filesystem effects.
Compare path components so intervening sibling names cannot hide selected ancestors.
Share ambiguity rejection with Shell destination verification; reject reserved DOS names, streams, unsupported namespaces and ambiguous components before alias folding.
Bound per-path depth at 256 and aggregate comparison components at 524288, preserving 32768 ordinary paths with 16 comparison components each.
Fail Windows CI when a configured Rust test filter matches no discovered tests.

linux_batch_tests.includes: Real case-distinct Linux files both execute independently; existing pre-effect overlap, deduplication and worker settlement contracts.

windows_cross_target.scope: Actual repository batch, Windows adapter, path helper, outcome modules and source-included tests; unrelated Tauri runtime and file helper shims. Dead-code allowance is for the standalone harness. This compiles Windows tests but does not execute them.

ci_filter_guard.method: Execute the exact AWK command extracted from the workflow against an actual cargo test --lib -- --list result.

limitations: No Windows host or Wine runtime was available. Windows behavior and maximum-shape latency remain unmeasured.
Physical aliases through 8.3 names, junctions, hardlinks, mapped drives and shares require native handle identity; lexical validation does not prove those identities.
Case-sensitive Windows directories are handled conservatively by case-insensitive selection rejection. macOS case-insensitive aliases are outside this change.
No new startup improvement or half-bounce result is claimed.
ADR 0020 is proposed design only: no durable journal, source parking, overwrite Undo or recovery UI is implemented by this checkpoint.

independent_review.verdict: ACCEPT static Windows path boundary; CONFIRMED batch integration, CI guard and proposed ADR; Windows maximum-shape wall time only PLAUSIBLE until measured
independent_review.remaining: Physical alias identity, filesystem case/upcase behavior and actual supported-platform acceptance remain open.
